suppress.notes: CVE-2026-66299 affects Tomcat's example WebSocket chat application. Spring Boot's embedded Tomcat dependencies do not ship the examples web application. Remove this suppression after upgrading to the first fixed Tomcat 10.1.x release (10.1.58+).

Dependency-Check identifies Guava metadata embedded in Error Prone's compiler-only dataflow artifact. It is not part of the runtime application, and current Error Prone releases still use dataflow-errorprone 3.41.0-eisop1. Re-evaluate when that artifact updates. Matches both the shaded jar and nested pom.xml paths under that jar.

False positive: CVE-2026-18022 is an IVFFlat integer-wraparound in the PostgreSQL pgvector C extension (fixed in extension 0.8.6), not in com.pgvector:pgvector (Java JDBC type bindings). Latest Java client remains 0.1.6; runtime risk is the server extension on 32-bit hosts — MVP targets 64-bit PostgreSQL 16. Re-evaluate if NVD CPE mapping for the Java artifact is corrected or a new Java client ships. Report evidence: pkg:maven/com.pgvector/pgvector@0.1.6 matched via CPE cpe:2.3:a:pgvector_project:pgvector (native extension), not the Java client.
